defect: New project can resurrect old project
evidence/reproduction: Primary key was removed but recovery/meta remained; safeLoad then loaded the old recovery snapshot.
resolution: New Project now clears primary, recovery, metadata, and per-device onboarding marker.

defect: Privacy-minimized copy accepted as recovery backup
evidence/reproduction: Privacy copy contains omitted raw data/manuscript placeholders but restore treated it like a full backup.
resolution: Privacy copies validate for integrity but are marked non-restorable and blocked by Recovery Center.

evidence/reproduction: AI could remain enabled/configurable after a project was frozen with AI disabled.
resolution: AI Coach visibility/settings are gated by the frozen project pilot policy.

defect: Public transfer bank not governed by transfer policy
evidence/reproduction: Public tasks could still be opened when transfer was disabled or a private evaluation bank was selected.
resolution: Public Transfer Lab is disabled after baseline start unless policy is classroom-practice.

evidence/reproduction: Legacy CSS hides phase navigation and there was no direct stage control.
resolution: Added mobile stage picker covering all 18 stages while preserving compact layout.

defect: Readiness/onboarding can throw when localStorage is unavailable
evidence/reproduction: storageReport/onboarding read localStorage outside protected calls.
resolution: All pilot-layer localStorage reads/removals used by these paths are guarded.

defect: Restored project leaves stale main UI until another render/reload
evidence/reproduction: Project object was replaced and saved while the background UI remained from the pre-restore project.
resolution: Successful restore saves and reloads the application.

defect: Duplicate review-packet imports inflate class counts
evidence/reproduction: The same project packet could be pushed multiple times.
resolution: Imports now upsert by project_id and replace the earlier packet.

defect: Backup filenames collide and are hard to distinguish
evidence/reproduction: Generic names made repeated/project-specific backups difficult to identify.
resolution: Backup filenames include sanitized project name, mode, and timestamp.

defect: Initial save label implies a save before persistence occurs
evidence/reproduction: Header said Saved locally before first save and did not reflect loaded timestamp.
resolution: Header starts Not saved yet and initializes from stored save metadata.

defect: Headless Chromium could not complete in container
evidence/reproduction: Chromium/Playwright navigation was blocked or hung due container administrator/DBus restrictions.
resolution: Automated engine/static dry run completed; real-device browser matrix remains a required pre-pilot manual step.
